question: Under 'PM Vishwakarma Yojana' benefits 2024 a loan of Rs. _______ is given at 5% interest.
solution:
The correct answer is __**3,00,000**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Under 'PM Vishwakarma Yojana,' artisans and craftsmen can avail of financial support.
 
• A loan amount of Rs. 3,00,000 is provided at a subsidized interest rate of 5%.
 
• This scheme aims to empower traditional artisans and craftsmen by providing them with the necessary financial assistance.
 
• Loans under this scheme can be used for business expansion, purchasing equipment, or other business-related needs.
 
• The scheme is part of a broader initiative to support the traditional crafts sector and enhance the livelihood of skilled craftsmen.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PM Vishwakarma Yojana**

 
 
• Launched to support traditional artisans and craftsmen across various sectors.
 
• Aims to preserve and promote the rich heritage of traditional craftsmanship in India.
 
• Provides financial assistance, skill development training, and market access to beneficiaries.
 
• The scheme also focuses on enhancing the quality and productivity of traditional crafts.
 
 
 
• **Eligibility Criteria**
 
 
• Available to traditional artisans and craftsmen.
 
• Applicants must have a valid identification and proof of their craft.
 
• The scheme is targeted at individuals who are part of the unorganized sector.
 
 
 
• **Implementation**
 
 
• Implemented through various financial institutions and government agencies.
 
• Applications can be submitted online or through designated centers.
 
• Beneficiaries receive training and support in addition to financial assistance.
 
 
 
• **Impact**
 
 
• Aims to improve the socio-economic status of traditional artisans.
 
• Encourages the younger generation to take up traditional crafts.
 
• Contributes to the preservation of India's cultural heritage.
